source: A thermostat compares measured room temperature with a target. In heating mode, it requests heat below the lower threshold and stops above the upper threshold. The gap reduces frequent switching.
expectations: Define threshold and show how two thresholds reduce switching.
knownBadRewrite: A thermostat knows when everyone is comfortable.

source: Give a finished explanation of a cache hit. A hit occurs when the requested item is already in the cache; a miss requires another lookup. Do not ask me questions. Give the finished text in a short paragraph.
expectations: Give a worked new lookup rather than forcing the user to answer a quiz.
Use the same item to show how a change in cache contents changes a hit into a miss, or a miss into a hit. Keep any unspecified storage policy conditional.
Do not claim that the user has demonstrated mastery.
Keep the worked prediction and explanation in the requested single short paragraph.
knownBadRewrite: Before I explain, answer these five questions.

source: This study found an association between sleep duration and test scores; it did not establish a causal effect.
expectations: Keep the distinction between association and causation.
Do not invent a causal mechanism as established study evidence.

source: A Python station importer applies lru_cache(maxsize=2) to a function that strips and case-folds a station name. Follow two consecutive calls with the same input in a single thread, then clear the cache and repeat.
expectations: The second call hits; the first call after clearing misses while returning the same normalized station name.

source: Each greenhouse valve stays open for six minutes after its own trigger, then shuts. West triggers at 08:01; East at 08:05. A monitor updates its display at 08:06 without controlling either valve. What does each valve do at 08:08? What if East had never triggered?
expectations: West closed at 08:07; East remains open until 08:11. The display update controls neither timer.
Without the East trigger its valve would stay closed; West is unaffected.
